# Courier's Stride

*Perrin, the Royal Courier, will teach his burst of speed to anyone who can run his old test: the palace steps, the great gate and back to him in the plaza.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Selsior](../towns/selsior_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Perrin](../npcs/perrin.md) |
| Level | 20 |
| After | [Clear the Stretch](../quests/perrin_clear_the_stretch.md) |

## Objectives

1. Reach the palace steps in [Palace](../maps/selsior_palace.md)
2. Reach the great gate in [Selsior Gate](../maps/selsior_gate.md)
3. Talk to [Perrin](../npcs/perrin.md)

## Rewards

- 1,800 EXP
- Skill: [Courier's Stride](../skills/tutors.md#couriers-stride)
- +30 standing with Selsior
- +120 standing with [Perrin](../npcs/perrin.md)
